finding: FieldView Drive collects, stores and transfers field data in real time.
Harvest data can be analyzed by field, soil and seed type.
Vegetation maps support seasonal crop-health monitoring.
Scouting maps and saved field pins support targeted scouting.
Seed and fertility prescription workflows are documented.
External API connectivity is offered in a paid plan.
Root-zone sensors measure soil moisture, temperature and salinity across multiple depths.
Root-zone and canopy data are used to generate agronomic irrigation insights and recommendations.
Disease Insights are exposed by crop zone in web and mobile workflows.
CropX documents measured Actual Evapotranspiration (ETa), which is adjacent to but not equivalent to reference ET0.
Management zones can be generated from satellite, topography, soil, sensor, yield and as-applied datasets.
VRA maps are exportable in machinery-compatible formats including ISOXML.
Yield data analytics and correction workflows are documented.
Planned and applied VRA maps can be compared and execution results monitored.
Field changes can be tracked offline and synchronized in the operations workflow.
Offline georeferenced scouting supports photos, notes and voice recordings.
Machinery and telematics brands can be connected with task, track and yield-map import.
Satellite, soil, yield and scouting data can be overlaid to identify productivity zones.
Prescription maps can be built and transferred to connected machinery.
Satellite monitoring includes NDVI and other vegetation indices for crop-health tracking.
Crop monitoring exposes weather and stress risk analysis including cold and heat stress.
Mobile and web products share fields and observations for monitoring and scouting.
Productivity analysis and zone workflows are supported.
VRA maps are supported in the platform.
Soil sampling workflows are listed as a platform capability.
The platform integrates with John Deere Operations Center and machinery formats.
Yield data can be imported through machinery integration workflows.
Prescription formats can be exported to connected machinery workflows.
The product describes NDVI-based crop and moisture monitoring with alerts.
